records.text: CERN placed a statue of the Hindu god Shiva outside its entrance.
records.speaker: Rob Skiba

appearances.snippet: Well, it's interesting that all these scientists and people working over there on CERN decide to put the religious statue of the Hindu god Shiva outside the front door.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. CERN official material confirms that India gifted CERN a two-metre Shiva Nataraja statue and that it was unveiled on CERN grounds. The statement is accurate in substance.

appearances.snippet: And on the matter of science, even when it's in our faces, like when the world's leading nuclear physicists are caught. ... cloaked before a statue of Shiva stabbing a woman in an occult ceremony for CERN, well, you guys, that's just science.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 5:16. A staged mock-sacrifice video was filmed without authorization at CERN near the Shiva statue, but reporting identifies it as a prank/mock ritual and does not establish that the participants were the world's leading nuclear physicists or that an actual stabbing/occult ceremony occurred.
